prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical low-angle streetwear lifestyle portrait of an adult silver-blonde woman seated reflectively beside a faded graffiti-covered brick wall at dusk. She wears black over-ear headphones, an oversized plaid flannel shirt, loose cargo pants, and worn white sneakers. Place a scuffed skateboard leaning beside her, a wall-mounted street lamp above, and rough asphalt with small debris below. Use warm street-lamp light mixed with soft twilight, amber highlights on the brick, muted graffiti color, gentle shadows, natural fabric texture, and a quiet non-sexualized urban-solitude mood. Keep graffiti abstract with no readable text, logo, or watermark.
